data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1 (Step 4 plan review feedback): (a) Skeleton leaf bodies MUST each raise NotImplementedError explicitly — guarantees RED state for downstream task-4/5/7 tests. (b) DO NOT MERGE task-3 INDEPENDENTLY — task-3 + task-4 + task-5 + task-7 must land atomically (same commit / story branch merge) since task-3 alone produces non-deployable applier.py. (c) Define Direction and Action enums in task-1 _errors.py (rename module purpose to _domain.py or co-locate types) — task-3 needs these for _LEAVES dict keys. (d) Define RETRY_BUDGET constant in task-1 OR task-3 at the same scope; value 3 (matches current _call_with_retry max_retries default). (e) Clarify apply() input contract: accepts Mutation typed object from draft-1 (new), NOT old dict format; task-3 updates all existing test_applier.py call sites to use Mutation; backward-compat shim out of scope (existing dict-based tests rewritten in task-3's UPDATE work). (f) Each leaf gets BOTH negative direction test (mismatch raises DirectionMismatchError) AND positive direction test (match calls downstream client method).
